# proxmox_node_ceph_rules (Data Source)

Lists CRUSH rule names from `/nodes/{node}/ceph/rules`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_ceph_rules" "r" { node = "pve-1" }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `rules` (List of String)
